title: Caring for sisters and brothers
intro: Our brothers and sisters are often our first and best friends.

learn.html: A childhood at home means good relations with every member of the family, especially our parents. After our parents, our brothers and sisters have an important place in our lives. They play with us, look after us and care for us. Growing up together, our love grows and life becomes happier. We share our first experiences and habits with them, tell them our secrets, and ask them for help with school and maktab work.

For good relations, brothers and sisters should love, respect and understand each other. We listen to and respect our older brothers and sisters and ask them what we don’t know. We look after and protect our younger ones and teach them good manners.
Islam teaches that even when we grow up and life separates us, we must keep in touch with our brothers and sisters.

learn.text: Our duties to brothers and sisters

items: helping them with money if we can
visiting and caring for them when they are ill
sharing their sadness and their joy
praying the janazah when they die
asking Allah to forgive their sins

learn.title: Two kinds of kinship
learn.html: In Islam there are two kinds of kinship: by blood and by milk (being nursed by the same woman).

learn.title: ⭐ Remember
learn.html: By fulfilling our duties to brothers and sisters, we grow love and respect, earn Allah’s pleasure and a reward in the next world.

practice.title: Older or younger?
practice.prompt: What do we do toward older or younger brothers and sisters?

items.text: Ask them what we don’t know

questions.q: What should brothers and sisters have for each other?
Must we keep in touch with siblings when we grow up?
What are the two kinds of kinship in Islam?

practice.title: Talk and tasks
prompts: 💬 Do people care more for their brothers and sisters – or less? Is arguing a way to solve problems?
🎁 Make a lovely gift for your brother or sister – friends at maktab can help with ideas.
🗣️ Talk with your parents about how lovely it is to have a brother or sister as a best friend.
